meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把内容做成可翻页的演示 deck：每页有独立幻灯片、分步显现、可点击热区跳转分支等交互，并带演讲者备注；也能把已有网页转成同款 deck。产出是可交互的 deck，不是 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 你明确说要幻灯片、slide show 或 HyperFrames 幻灯片时直接做；若只提到 presentation、pitch deck、convert this page 等，会先询问确认；通过 /hyperframes 进入则视为已确认。

say.text: 把我这个网页转成一套幻灯片 deck，保留原有动效。
做一份 pitch deck，标题页加演讲者备注。
给第 3 页加一个跳转分支和两处点击热区。
say.note: 他会往 deck 里加入可点击热区和分支序列。

howto.what_en: Claude will build a runnable HyperFrames slide deck: discrete slides, staged reveals, branching hotspots, etc., plus presenter notes. It can also convert an existing page into the same deck form. The deliverable is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on an explicit slideshow or HyperFrames slideshow request. Adjacent requests like presentation, pitch deck, or convert this page get a confirmation prompt first. Via /hyperframes it's pre-confirmed.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a slide deck, keeping the original motion.
say_en.note: It will ask for confirmation before converting.

say_en.text: Create a pitch deck with speaker notes on the title slide.
say_en.note: Open the deck with hyperframes present.

say_en.text: Add a branch and two clickable hotspots to slide 3.
say_en.note: It adds interactive hotspots plus a branch.
